source: After days of Trump's "grab them by the pussy" comments dominating the news, the story begins to move on to other things, not the least of which is these leaks.
zh: 在特朗普的“抓住他们的阴部”评论占据新闻头几天之后，故事开始转向其他事情，其中​​最重要的是这些泄密。

source: After a few days, Comey does announce that no new evidence was found. Unfortunately for you, there was a definite effect on the polls as early voting began.
zh: 几天后，科米确实宣布没有发现新的证据。对你来说不幸的是，随着提前投票的开始，民意调查受到了一定的影响。

source: It's not hard to notice your progressive emphasis with this answer.
zh: 不难注意到您在这个答案中逐渐强调的内容。

source: Fighting for the rebirth of a public option is a mainstream position for the Democrats.
zh: 争取公共选择的重生是民主党的主流立场。

source: Supports and opponents both note that you are not really rocking the boat on this issue.
zh: 支持者和反对者都指出，你在这个问题上并没有真正造成影响。

source: It may have been an off-the-cuff statement, but it has erupted onto the headlines, likely to your detriment.
zh: 这可能是一个即兴陈述，但它已经成为头条新闻，可能对您不利。

source: Whatever else people can say about this campaign, it certainly hasn't lacked in verbal combat between you and Mr. Trump.
zh: 无论人们对这次活动还有什么看法，它肯定不乏你和特朗普先生之间的口水战。

source: Behind the scenes, Obama is not too pleased with your lukewarm stance. One way or another, rumors of a rift leak into the political press.
zh: 在幕后，奥巴马对你冷淡的态度不太满意。不管怎样，政治媒体中流传着两人之间关系不和的谣言。

source: Your talk about an “appallingly low” level and “millions” of refugees immediately starts the right-wing rumor mill churning about your refugee plans.
zh: 你关于“低得惊人”的水平和“数百万”难民的言论立即引发了右翼谣言工厂对你的难民计划的炒作。

source: Some of your supporters are upset that you aren't taking a stronger stand on admitting Syrian refugees.
zh: 您的一些支持者对您在接纳叙利亚难民问题上没有采取更强硬的立场感到不安。

source: Some critics are saying that Cory Booker's resume is a little thin to be named as your running mate, and that you are dangerously close to pandering. What is your response?
zh: 一些批评者说，科里·布克的简历被任命为你的竞选搭档有点单薄，而且你接近迎合的危险。你的回应是什么？

source: What is your position on the Trans-Pacific Partnership? Would you pursue further trade agreements as President?
zh: 您对跨太平洋伙伴关系持什么立场？作为总统，您会寻求进一步的贸易协定吗？

source: Cory Booker and I will both fight to ensure that all Americans have health care, economic security, and acess to clean water. I'm proud to name him as my running mate.
zh: 科里·布克和我都将努力确保所有美国人都有医疗保健、经济安全和获得清洁水。我很自豪地任命他为我的竞选搭档。

source: Cory Booker has been a tireless advocate on behalf of the people of New Jersey, and on behalf of African-Americans everywhere. He will make sure that all groups have the voice they deserve in my Administration.
zh: 科里·布克一直是代表新泽西州人民和世界各地非裔美国人的不懈倡导者。他将确保所有团体在我的政府中拥有应有的发言权。

source: Cory Booker really impressed me with his thoughtfulness, intelligence, experience, and ability to step in at a moment's notice, should the situation demand it.
zh: 科里·布克他的深思熟虑、智慧、经验以及在情况需要时立即介入的能力给我留下了深刻的印象。

source: Donald Trump's actions and comments about women are reprehensible. It would be asburd of us not to bring that up as we campaign, along with other important issues.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对女性的行为和评论应受到谴责。如果我们在竞选时不把这个问题和其他重要问题一起提出来，那就太荒唐了。

source: The level of disruption from globalization has simply been too much for American workers over the past few years. I don't support TPP, and there will be a pause on any new trade deals during my Presidency.
zh: 过去几年，全球化的破坏程度对于美国工人来说实在是太大了。我不支持TPP，在我担任总统期间任何新的贸易协议都将暂停。

source: I was a supporter of this deal at first, but I'm very disappointed to see some of the provisions that made it into the final version. I unfortunately cannot support the TPP at this point.
zh: 我一开始是这项协议的支持者，但我对最终版本中的一些条款感到非常失望。遗憾的是，我目前无法支持 TPP。

source: As it stands, this deal is a step in the right direction, but I have some real concerns as well. We're going to seriously reevaluate this deal when I'm in office, and work to renegotiate certain aspects of it.
zh: 就目前情况而言，这笔交易是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，但我也有一些真正的担忧。当我上任时，我们将认真重新评估这笔交易，并努力重新谈判其中的某些方面。

source: The TPP is a key piece of our battle against excessive Chinese influence in Asia, and it will lead to greater economic growth here in the United States. I support Barack Obama's efforts to pass this deal.
zh: TPP 是我们对抗中国在亚洲过度影响力的关键一环，它将带来美国更大的经济增长。我支持贝拉克·奥巴马为通过这项交易所做的努力。

source: I think it's obvious that we plan to spend a lot of time campaigning with Bernie Sanders, and that we're making a real effort to incorporate his message into our campaign.
zh: 我认为很明显，我们计划花费大量时间与伯尼·桑德斯一起开展竞选活动，并且我们正在努力将他的信息纳入我们的竞选活动中。

source: I want us to do a high-profile appearance with Bernie in Michigan, once the campaign gets going. We don't agree on every issue, but I want to embrace his economic message and show people that our party is unified.
zh: 一旦活动开始，我希望我们与伯尼一起在密歇根州中高调亮相。我们并非在所有问题上都达成共识，但我想接受他的经济信息，并向人们表明我们党是团结的。

source: Bernie Sanders has offered to campaign extensively on our behalf, and of course we want to have him on the trail. I'm willing to make a few small promises to make that happen.
zh: 伯尼·桑德斯已提出代表我们进行广泛的竞选活动，当然我们希望让他参与其中。我愿意做出一些小承诺来实现这一目标。

source: I'd love to have Bernie Sanders out there campaigning for us, but the things he is asking for are simply unrealistic. I'm not going to sit here and bargain away my platform when I'm the one who won the nomination.
zh: 我很想让伯尼·桑德斯为我们竞选，但他要求的东西根本不现实。当我赢得提名时，我不会坐在这里讨价还价我的政治纲领。

source: Donald Trump is lying when says he opposed the war. I challenge him to produce a single public statement that he made before the Iraq War started -- as opposed to years after the fact.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普说他反对战争是在撒谎。我要求他发表一份他曾发表过的公开声明 之前 伊拉克战争开始了——而不是几年后。

source: Donald Trump has shown an alarming lack of knowledge about even the basics of U.S. foreign policy. He would set us back many, many years on our objectives in Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and elsewhere.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普甚至对美国外交政策的基础知识也缺乏了解，令人震惊。他将使我们在欧洲、亚洲、中东和其他地方的目标倒退很多很多年。

source: If I knew what I know now, I wouldn't have voted "yes". But real culprit of this war was George Bush and the Republicans, using faulty intelligence.
zh: 如果我知道我现在所知道的，我就不会投票“是”。但这场战争的真正罪魁祸首是乔治·布什和共和党，他们使用了错误的情报。

source: My vote in favor of this authorization was one of the toughest of my career. And I will admit, the war didn't go as well as Bush promised it would. But ultimately, we removed a murderous dictator and replaced him a parliamentary democracy.
zh: 我对这项授权的投票是我职业生涯中最艰难的投票之一。我承认，战争并没有像布什所承诺的那样进行。但最终，我们推翻了一位凶残的独裁者，取而代之的是议会民主制。

source: I will stand behind the "red lines" that we have set, and I will take vigorous action to defend the Syrian people against Assad, Russia, Iran, ISIS, and other malevolent influences.
zh: 我将站在我们设定的“红线”后面，并采取积极行动，保护叙利亚人民免受阿萨德、俄罗斯、伊朗、伊斯兰国和其他恶意影响。

source: There are no good options in Syria. We need to continue our support for the moderate rebels, and we need to defeat ISIS wherever they appear. I also support extensive aid and funding to countries that are bearing the brunt of the refugee problem.
zh: 叙利亚没有好的选择。我们需要继续支持温和的叛乱分子，我们需要击败任何出现的伊斯兰国。我还支持向遭受难民问题首当其冲的国家提供广泛的援助和资金。

source: Unfortunately, we are limited in what we can reasonably do in Syria. I support the creation of a safe zone in Syria, for opponents of ISIS and the Assad regime, that we will defend and provide aid to. Hopefully this can limit the humanitarian damage and refugee flows.
zh: 不幸的是，我们在叙利亚能做的合理事情是有限的。我支持在叙利亚为伊斯兰国和阿萨德政权的反对者建立一个安全区，我们将保卫这个安全区并为其提供援助。希望这能够限制人道主义损害和难民潮。

source: Victory in the Syrian Civil War for moderate rebel forces is an impossibility. We need to use our strength to negotiate a peace settlement that will protect their interests and lives, and get our troops out.
zh: 对于温和的叛军来说，在叙利亚南北战争取得胜利是不可能的。我们需要利用我们的力量来谈判达成一项和平解决方案，以保护他们的利益和生命，并让我们的军队撤离。

source: We take the issues affecting minority communities very seriously. We're going to push for police reform, clean water, economic justice, and we're going to denounce Trump's dangerous and hateful rhetoric.
zh: 我们非常重视影响少数群体社区的问题。我们将推动警察改革、清洁水、经济正义，我们将谴责特朗普的危险和仇恨言论。

source: Cory Booker has more experience in public service than Donald Trump by a mile. He is a sitting U.S. Senator. Any insinuation that he somehow isn't qualified is simply a phony attack by the right-wing outrage machine.
zh: 科里·布克在公共服务方面的经验比唐纳德·特朗普多得多。他是现任美国参议员。任何暗示他不合格的暗示都只是右翼愤怒机器的虚假攻击。

source: Pundits speculate on your attempts to recreate the "Obama coalition" with your running-mate.
zh: 专家猜测你试图与你的竞选搭档重建“奥巴马联盟”。

source: While some say this is yet another changed position on your part, it could help mend fences with the left of your party.
zh: 虽然有人说这是你立场的又一次改变，但它可能有助于修补与你的政党左翼的关系。

source: There are pros and cons to embracing Bernie so closely.
zh: 如此紧密地拥抱伯尼有利也有弊。

source: Who knows if it means anything nationally, but a raucous crowd turned out to support the two of you.
zh: 谁知道这在全国范围内是否意味着什么，但是喧闹的人群来支持你们两个。

source: The reluctance of Bernie to endorse you after a couple of personal meetings fuels rampant speculation about the causes.
zh: 伯尼在几次私人会议后不愿支持你，这引发了对其原因的广泛猜测。

source: Television commentator Sean Hannity recounts a single, private conversation between himself and Trump in 2003 where Trump said he opposed the war.
zh: 电视评论员 Sean Hannity 讲述了 2003 年他与特朗普之间的一次私人谈话，其中特朗普表示他反对战争。

source: “Clinton defends Iraq War” is the headline today. Your statement might be factually accurate, but it's out of step with the views of most in your party.
zh: “克林顿捍卫伊拉克战争”是今天的标题。你的说法可能实际上是准确的，但与你党内大多数人的观点不一致。

source: Most respected economists are highly critical of trade restrictions and protectionism, yet your running-mate is well known for espousing these positions. Is that something you also embrace?
zh: 最受尊敬的经济学家对贸易限制和保护主义持高度批评态度，但你的竞选搭档却以拥护这些立场而闻名。这也是你所拥抱的吗？

source: Sherrod Brown is serious about ensuring that all workers are well paid, and protected from the impact of unfair trade deals. We're going to give him a significant voice in my Administration.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗认真确保所有工人获得高薪，并受到保护，免受不公平贸易交易的影响。我们将让他在我的政府中拥有重要的发言权。

source: Sherrod Brown has served his home state of Ohio for most of his life, fighting for workers and everyday people. He has won numerous statewide elections there as well.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗大半生都在为他的家乡俄亥俄州服务，为工人和普通人而战。他还在那里赢得了多次全州选举。

source: Sherrod Brown has served as a Congressman and Senator for over 20 years, tirelessly advocating for the American people. He has the experience and qualifications that we need in our Administration.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗担任国会议员和参议员 20 多年，孜孜不倦地为美国人民辩护。他拥有我们政府所需的经验和资格。

source: The fact of the matter is, the deficit just isn't as important as some people make it out to be. If every person has access to a quality education and reliable health care, the economy will grow enough over time to make the deficit a non-issue.
zh: 事实是，赤字并不像某些人想象的那么重要。如果每个人都能获得优质教育和可靠的医疗保健，随着时间的推移，经济将增长到足以使赤字不再是问题。

source: Republicans rave about the deficit when a Democrat is President. But when it's time to cut taxes for the top 1%, suddenly it's not an issue any more. I wonder why that is?
zh: 当民主党担任总统时，共和党人对赤字赞不绝口。但当到了为最顶层 1% 的人减税的时候，突然间这不再是问题了。我想知道这是为什么？

source: Republican tax cuts from Reagan and Bush have driven the fiscal condition of this country into a dire condition. Now Donald Trump says he wants to cut taxes for the rich even more.
zh: 共和党的里根和布什减税措施已使该国的财政状况陷入困境。现在唐纳德·特朗普说他想进一步为富人减税。

source: We need to make the tough choices that will get our sprawling deficit under control. I will increase taxes on the 1% and continue the significant progress that Barack Obama has made in reducing our annual deficit.
zh: 我们需要做出艰难的选择，以控制我们庞大的赤字。我将增加 1% 的税收，并继续贝拉克·奥巴马在减少年度赤字方面取得的重大进展。

source: In a perfect world, with fair trade, then more trade is always better. But we cannot be blind to the fact that China and other countries are cheating and ignoring many provisions of our trade deals, and deeply harming American workers in the process.
zh: 在公平贸易的完美世界中，贸易越多越好。但我们不能忽视这样一个事实：中国和其他国家正在欺骗和无视我们贸易协定中的许多条款，并在此过程中深深伤害了美国工人。

source: Sherrod Brown also happens to be a deeply qualified Senator with extensive experience in government. And we must admit that the current system isn't working for places like Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, and others.
zh: 谢罗德·布朗也恰好是一位资深参议员，拥有丰富的政府经验。我们必须承认，当前系统不适用于俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州等地方。

source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for the rust belt.
zh: 专家指出，谢罗德·布朗是一个令人惊讶的民粹主义选择，并立即关注锈带的影响。

source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for Ohio and the rust belt.
zh: 专家指出，谢罗德·布朗是一个令人惊讶的民粹主义选择，并立即关注对俄亥俄州和锈带的影响。

source: Some mainstream economists question your logic on this issue, but this position plays well on the left.
zh: 一些主流经济学家质疑你在这个问题上的逻辑，但这个立场在左派中发挥得很好。

source: Right-wing media spins your promise to raise taxes. The left is concerned about what exactly your "tough choices" will be.
zh: 右翼媒体歪曲你加税的承诺。左派担心你的“艰难选择”到底是什么。

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Bernie Sanders as your running mate?
zh: 您选择伯尼·桑德斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: Some of your most ardent supporters, including some major donors, are wondering about your judgment in selecting Bernie Sanders as a running mate. Can you say something to reassure them?
zh: 你的一些最热心的支持者，包括一些主要捐助者，想知道你选择伯尼·桑德斯作为竞选搭档的判断。你能说些什么让他们放心吗？

source: Bernie Sanders is going to be a very active part of my Administration. We both want what's best for this country and his input will be taken very seriously.
zh: 伯尼·桑德斯将成为我的政府中非常活跃的一部分。我们都希望为这个国家带来最好的结果，他的意见将得到非常认真的对待。

source: The differences between us are much smaller than the things that unite us. We both wake up every day and fight for average Americans -- for their health care, their housing and education costs, and their personal rights.
zh: 我们之间的差异远小于将我们团结在一起的事物。我们每天醒来都为普通美国人而战——为他们的医疗保健、住房和教育费用以及个人权利而战。

source: During the past few months, our party has spoken, and we can't deny that Bernie Sanders enjoys a huge amount of support. It's only right that we join forces, and together prevent any possibility of a Trump Administration.
zh: 在过去的几个月里，我们党已经发声了，我们不能否认伯尼·桑德斯享有大量的支持。我们联手并共同防止任何特朗普政府的可能性是正确的。
